boundary_conditions: wall_u_value * dT_dx(1) = wall_solar_absorptance * screen_solar_transmittance * solar_irradiance_daily_mean + cavity_convection_coefficient * (ambient_temperature - T(1)) + radiative_exchange_coefficient * (ambient_temperature + (screen_solar_absorptance * solar_irradiance_daily_mean - screen_thermal_emittance * net_sky_longwave) / (2 * screen_convection_coefficient) - T(1))

parameters.name: indoor_temperature
parameters.justification: Conditioned interior; x=0 interior, x=1 outer wall surface behind the screen.

parameters.name: wall_solar_absorptance
parameters.justification: The wall behind keeps its aged white paint.

parameters.name: radiative_exchange_coefficient
parameters.justification: Linearised longwave exchange between wall and screen, 4*sigma*T^3/(1/e1+1/e2-1) with e ~0.9.

parameters.name: screen_convection_coefficient
parameters.justification: Convection on each face of the ventilated screen; the screen temperature is its own balance T_a + (alpha_f*I - eps_f*R_net)/(2*h_f).
